rules.title: The snapshot carries no measured identity or not exactly FortiADC-KVM 7.6.7 build 0676, so no other rule of the catalog was evaluated over it.
rules.remediation: Audit a snapshot read from FortiADC-KVM 7.6.7 build 0676 and pass its metadata with --snapshot-meta.
refs: FortiADC 7.6.7 CLI Reference: get system status (379949)
rules.known_false_positives: The identity comes from the metadata file bound to the snapshot digest, never from the configuration text; a metadata file written by hand is trusted as far as the operator who wrote it.

rules.title: The configuration is organized into VDOMs or wrapped in a global or vdom block, a scope this catalog does not read, so no other rule of the catalog was evaluated over it.
rules.remediation: Audit a single-VDOM configuration or each VDOM separately once the catalog supports it.
refs: FortiADC 7.6.7 CLI Reference: config system vdom (42122)
rules.known_false_positives: Fires on any vdom or global block and on more than one system vdom entry; how a real FortiADC export names the VDOM scopes has not been measured.

rules.title: An administrator account explicitly allows management logins from any address.
rules.remediation: Restrict trusted-hosts of the account to the management networks.
refs: FortiADC 7.6.7 CLI Reference: config system admin (548549)
rules.known_false_positives: Only an explicit open trusted-hosts is reported; the default is documented by an example only, so an account without the attribute makes the rule not evaluated. The accepted notations are 0.0.0.0/0, ::/0 and the pair 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0.

rules.title: An interface explicitly allows management over a plaintext protocol (http or telnet).
rules.remediation: Remove http and telnet from allowaccess of the interface.
refs: FortiADC 7.6.7 CLI Reference: config system interface (202041)
rules.known_false_positives: Only an explicit allowaccess is read; the default is not documented, so an interface without it makes the rule not evaluated. Which access-profile area covers system interface is not confirmed, so both system and networking limit the rule.

rules.title: A client SSL profile explicitly allows SSLv3, TLS 1.0 or TLS 1.1.
rules.remediation: Limit ssl-allowed-versions of the profile to tlsv1.2 and tlsv1.3.
refs: FortiADC 7.6.7 CLI Reference: config load-balance client-ssl-profile (774093)
rules.known_false_positives: Only an explicit ssl-allowed-versions is read; the example value of the reference is not a default. Predefined profiles are not part of show and are not judged.

rules.title: Certificate group bound to a client SSL profile is reported for diagnosis; a factory origin is never concluded from a name such as default.
rules.remediation: Confirm the origin of the certificate with the vendor tooling before judging it.
refs: FortiADC 7.6.7 CLI Reference: config load-balance client-ssl-profile (774093)
FortiADC 7.6.7 CLI Reference: config system certificate local-cert-group (352203)
rules.known_false_positives: Always not evaluated: the reference defines default only as the default member of a certificate group and does not prove a factory origin; the bindings are listed in the status reason.

rules.title: A real server pool explicitly disables health checking.
rules.remediation: Enable health-check-ctrl and attach a health check to the pool.
refs: FortiADC 7.6.7 CLI Reference: config load-balance pool (445091)
rules.known_false_positives: Only an explicit disable is reported; the default is documented by an example only, so a pool without the attribute makes the rule not evaluated.

rules.title: A real server pool has exactly one member.
rules.remediation: Add a second member or accept the single point of failure.
refs: FortiADC 7.6.7 CLI Reference: config load-balance pool (445091)
rules.known_false_positives: A deliberately single-server service is reported as well.
